changes.rule_name: Alabama PSC generic proceeding on contracts between Alabama Power and large load data center customers (Docket 33709)
changes.source_title: Alabama Public Service Commission, Minutes of the Commission Meeting held Tuesday, October 6, 2026
changes.what: On 6 October 2026 the Commission unanimously adopted the Docket 33709 procedures for large load data center customers as defined by Act 610: Alabama Power files a public Petition to Contract with a contract summary and gives the full contract and supporting analysis to the Commission's Legal Division and the Attorney General; each contract is approved or disapproved by Commission vote with no hearing or intervention, but is deemed approved if the Commission fails to vote within 90 days of the Petition (amended from the July proposal's 60 days); Alabama Power is to file the Petition at least 120 days before the contract would become void, and to file a compliance tariff within ten calendar days of the order's effective date.

cites.quote: The October 2026 meeting of the Alabama Public Service Commission was held on Tuesday, October 6, 2026
DOCKET 33709, Generic Proceeding to Establish a Process for Consideration of Contracts for Electric Service Between Alabama Power Company and Large Load Data Center Customers
The following procedures are applicable to large load data center customers as defined by Act 610.

AMENDED: DECISION AND REVIEW. Contracts submitted under this process shall be approved or disapproved through a Commission vote; however, if the Commission fails to vote within 90 days from the filing of the Petition, then the Petition is deemed approved.
Within ten calendar days of the effective date of this order, Alabama Power shall file a tariff that complies with the requirements of this order.
Upon approval of the amendment, the Commissioners voted unanimously to accept the entire recommendation.
